protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: acfc02ee8a04629c1318da1b21a98432546f09e4 added POST /api/av/getAttributeViewFieldViews with CheckAuth only. At that commit CheckAuth admits RoleReader, while the handler accepts caller-supplied avID/keyID and GetAttributeViewFieldViews parses that AV and returns every view's ID, icon, name, layout type, and field Hidden value without a publish-access check. The adjacent getAttributeViewKeys already filters read-only-role results through FilterBlockAttributeViewKeysByPublishAccess. The live CVE.org record is PUBLISHED and describes this same disclosure.
